email=apis.spotify.show_account(access_token=access_token)['email']

# re-fetch liked playlists and build song_id set
liked_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    liked_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

song_ids=set()
for p in liked_playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]):
        song_ids.add(int(sid))

song_ids=sorted(song_ids)
print('liked playlist count',len(liked_playlists))
print('unique song_ids in those playlists',len(song_ids))

# fetch reviews by this user for each song, full pagination
reviews_by_song={}
for sid in song_ids:
    page_index=0
    all_reviews=[]
    while True:
        r=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid,user_email=email,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
        if not r:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(r)
        page_index+=1
    reviews_by_song[sid]=all_reviews

# classify
songs_already_5=[]
to_update=[] # list of (review_id,song_id,current_rating)
to_create=[] # song_id
for sid,revs in reviews_by_song.items():
    if not revs:
        to_create.append(sid)
    else:
        # if multiple, any with rating<5 should be updated
        for rv in revs:
            if float(rv['rating'])>=5:
                songs_already_5.append(sid)
            else:
                to_update.append((rv['song_review_id'],sid,float(rv['rating'])))

print('songs with existing reviews',sum(1 for sid in reviews_by_song if reviews_by_song[sid]))
print('to_update reviews',len(to_update))
print('to_create reviews',len(to_create))
# show detail for updates
print('update list',to_update)
print('create list',to_create)
# verify uniqueness for song IDs
update_song_ids=sorted(set(sid for _,sid,_ in to_update))
create_song_ids=sorted(set(to_create))
print('unique songs to update',len(update_song_ids))
print('unique songs to create',len(create_song_ids))
print('overlap update/create',set(update_song_ids).intersection(set(create_song_ids)))
